name: netlens
description: NetLens — a self-hosted dashboard for UniFi networks. • Usage per device and app, with time charts • Sites each device visited, by category • Devices: presence, rename, block • Wi-Fi signal, roaming and failed joins • Blocked traffic and intrusions, ads apart • Daily alerts per app and device Keeps 30 days of detail and 90 days of events, well beyond UniFi's own. Needs a UniFi OS console and a local API key. Not affiliated with Ubiquiti.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Cache, settings and logs. Keep it on appdata so updates never lose history.

ports.description: Port for the dashboard in your browser.
